# Synthetic validation cohort

**Software validation data only — not biological evidence.**

Generated by `make_synthetic_cohort.py` (seed 20260913); regenerate with
`python tests/fixtures/make_synthetic_cohort.py`.

60 samples across 4 lineages; 35 resistant.

| Candidate | Planted truth | Expected disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `true_compensatory` | three independent origins, all post-resistance | convergent |
| `clonal_marker` | one origin, inherited by one whole lineage | not convergent |
| `wrong_direction` | concentrated in susceptible genomes | rejected |
| `near_fixed` | present in almost every genome | uninformative |
